title: Canonical Fact
description: One immutable, typed assertion about one field on one canonical entity, with independent production, verification, and lifecycle states.

id.description: Permanent UUID for this assertion; never reused or reassigned.

schema_version.description: Version of the Fact contract used to validate this record.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when the immutable assertion was first created; never changes.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest permitted administrative update; it never authorizes mutation of assertion content.

source_ids.description: Immutable non-empty set of Source IDs providing direct provenance for the assertion.

confidence_score.description: Current evidence-strength assessment; this administrative assessment may change after review.

value_classification.description: Immutable classification of whether the value was observed, estimated, or derived.

verification_status.description: Mutable review state; disputed Facts retain their value and production metadata.

lifecycle_status.description: Mutable administrative state; superseded and deprecated Facts remain queryable.

notes.description: Mutable review or administrative notes; never a substitute for structured provenance.

entity_type.description: Canonical structural entity collection containing the subject of this assertion.

entity_id.description: Immutable UUID of the subject record in the collection named by entity_type.

field_name.description: Immutable stable field path; a future field catalog may constrain its type and unit.

value_type.description: Immutable discriminator selecting the sole permitted JSON representation of observed_value.

observed_value.description: Immutable non-null observed, estimated, or derived value whose representation is enforced by value_type.

unit.description: Immutable numeric unit. Use unitless for ratios and counts, percent for percentage points, and decimal_fraction for ratios from 0 to 1; non-numeric values use null.

observation_date.description: Immutable date the assertion was first observed in cited evidence.

effective_date.description: Immutable real-world effective date; null when evidence does not establish one.

superseded_by_fact_id.description: Mutable reciprocal link to the direct replacement; required only when lifecycle_status is superseded.

supersedes_fact_ids.description: Mutable reciprocal links to directly replaced Facts; history remains stored.

input_fact_ids.description: Immutable calculation inputs; non-empty only for derived Facts and preserved through every state.

derivation_method.description: Immutable reproducible formula or versioned transformation for a derived Fact; null otherwise.

estimation_method.description: Immutable method used for an estimated Fact; null otherwise.

estimation_assumptions.description: Immutable non-empty assumptions for an estimated Fact; null otherwise.
